title: maint.event.v1{kind=backup_cold_verify_completed}
description: Phase 8 §8.3 — emitted by maint.backup.v1 when the weekly cold-verify pass on the oldest still-retained Sunday dump succeeds. Notification only; cold-verify never auto-prunes.

dump_date.description: ISO calendar date (UTC) of the Sunday dump that was cold-verified.

verified.description: Always true on this kind — failed cold-verify uses backup_cold_verify_failed.

verify_summary.description: Per-table row counts + schema_migrations max version returned by the verifier.
